SQLite şeması: v23_sc04_sql_251_assets(asset_key_value TEXT), v23_sc04_sql_251_events(event_no TEXT, asset_ref TEXT, recorded_at_amount TEXT, duration_amount REAL). :start ve :end arasında varlık bazında AVG hesabı yap. SELECT a.asset_key_value, COALESCE(AVG(e.duration_amount), 0.0) AS result
```sql
FROM v23_sc04_sql_251_assets a
LEFT JOIN v23_sc04_sql_251_events e ON a.asset_key_value = e.asset_ref AND e.recorded_at_amount BETWEEN :start AND :end
GROUP BY a.asset_key_value
ORDER BY a.asset_key_value
```

SQLite şeması: v23_sc08_sql_065_assets(asset_key TEXT), v23_sc08_sql_065_events(event_no TEXT, asset_ref_amount TEXT, recorded_at TEXT, duration_value REAL). :start ve :end arasında varlık bazında AVG hesabı yap. Aralıkta olayı olmayan varlıkları da 0 ile göster. Tek salt okunur SQL üret; tarihleri parametre olarak kullan.

```sql
SELECT a.asset_key, COALESCE(AVG(e.duration_value), 0.0) AS result
FROM v23_sc08_sql_065_assets a
LEFT JOIN v23_sc08_sql_065_events e ON a.asset_key = e.asset_ref_amount AND e.recorded_at BETWEEN :start AND :end
GROUP BY a.asset_key
ORDER BY a.asset_key
```
